instruction:
Append material `StudioBrass` from `/home/user/Desktop/materials.blend` into `/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend`, assign it to `Target`, and save `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`. ## Requirements 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` exists. 2. Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal. On this machine, use `/opt/blender/blender` for Blender command-line or background runs when working on `materials.blend`.

The object `Target` exists and is a MESH. 3. `bpy.data.materials.get('StudioBrass')` is not None. 4. `bpy.data.materials['StudioBrass'].library is None` (appended, not linked). 5. `Target.material_slots[0].material.name == 'StudioBrass'`. 6. The `StudioBrass` Principled BSDF has Metallic == 1.0 and Base Color with R > 0.7, G > 0.5, B < 0.3. Do not rename the `Target` object or the `StudioBrass` material.
